Workspace ONE® UEM™

Embrace cloud-native unified endpoint management, built for any device and any use case.

CONTACT US

What is Workspace ONE UEM?

Workspace ONE UEM is a cloud‑native unified endpoint management platform that helps IT teams manage desktops, mobile, rugged, servers, and specialty devices across Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Linux, and ChromeOS from a single console.

Streamlined, autonomous IT operations

Reduce complexity and break down silos with centralized management across all endpoints. Eliminate repetitive manual tasks using AI-driven automation, freeing IT teams to focus on strategic initiatives.

Security-hardened by design

Experience integrated security across onboarding, configuration, updates, and support. Conditional access, compliance policies, and device posture checks help protect devices and data without sacrificing productivity.

Frictionless employee experiences

Anticipate and resolve endpoint issues before users are affected, and deliver seamless onboarding, app access, and self-service tools to help employees stay productive anywhere.

Features

Streamline IT operations with Workspace ONE UEM features

Workspace ONE UEM delivers automation, full application lifecycle management, and policy controls to help IT teams reduce manual work, improve device compliance, and enhance user experience. 

Multi-tenant architecture for scalable management

Localize policy and access across business units or geographies with granular controls. This structure helps organizations securely delegate administration and maintain governance at scale.

Learn more about organization groups

IT orchestration and automation

Automate onboarding, app deployment, and remediation tasks with low-/no-code workflows. IT orchestration helps reduce repetitive work and helps support consistent policy enforcement across endpoints.

Learn more about Freestyle Orchestrator

App lifecycle management across device types

Deliver full app lifecycle across all types of apps. Workspace ONE Intelligent Hub brings a unified self-service app catalog with SSO to all apps including Office 365.

Learn more about app lifecycle management

Low touch remote onboarding

Provision new devices remotely, reducing the need for manual imaging or in-person setup. Employees can self-enroll and receive configurations instantly, supporting hybrid and distributed work. 
 

Learn more about enrollment

Role-based access control

Grant precise administrative permissions by user or group. Role-based controls help organizations align access with job functions, supporting oversight and can help reduce risk.

Managing admin roles with Workspace ONE

FAQ

Workspace ONE UEM is a cloud-native unified endpoint management product that enables IT to manage, provision, and secure virtually any device—including mobile, desktop, servers, and rugged endpoints—from a single console. 

It stands out for its modern, microservices-based architecture, multi-tenancy, automation capabilities, and deep integrations with Omnissa solutions and a broad ecosystem of technology partners.

Workspace ONE UEM supports operating systems including, but not limited to Windows, Windows Server, macOS, iOS, Android, Linux, and ChromeOS. It enables management of bring-your-own, corporate-owned, shared, and specialty endpoints for a broad range of use cases.

Workspace ONE UEM includes enterprise-grade security features such as conditional access, compliance policies, device posture checks, per-app VPN, and automated patch management. These controls help organizations reduce risk and support regulatory compliance. 

Workspace ONE UEM uses a subscription licensing model and is offered in multiple use case-based editions. Pricing varies by device or user count and feature set. Review the comparison table or contact us for detailed pricing and licensing options. 

Deployment resources include step-by-step documentation, best practices, and architecture diagrams. Guided onboarding is available through Omnissa Tech Zone and support channels, making it straightforward to implement Workspace ONE UEM in your environment. 

Workspace ONE UEM integrates with leading identity providers, certificate authorities, and productivity tools. It also supports API-based integration for custom workflows and automation, as well as compatibility with other Omnissa products and third-party solutions. 

Support is available 24x7 through Omnissa Customer Connect. Training modules, documentation, and a community forum are also available to help users and administrators maximize value from Workspace ONE UEM. 

Workspace ONE UEM features low-/no-code orchestration tools to automate onboarding, app deployment, compliance checks, and remediation. Automation helps IT teams reduce manual work and maintain consistent endpoint policy enforcement.

Support is available 24x7 through Omnissa Customer Connect. Training modules, documentation, and a community forum are also available to help users and administrators maximize value from Workspace ONE UEM. 

Workspace ONE UEM features low-/no-code orchestration tools to automate onboarding, app deployment, compliance checks, and remediation. Automation helps IT teams reduce manual work and maintain consistent endpoint policy enforcement.

Workspace ONE UEM is a cloud‑native unified endpoint management platform that helps IT teams manage desktops, mobile, rugged, servers, and specialty devices across Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Linux, and ChromeOS from a single console.

Streamlined, autonomous IT operations

Reduce complexity and break down silos with centralized management across all endpoints. Eliminate repetitive manual tasks using AI-driven automation, freeing IT teams to focus on strategic initiatives.

Security-hardened by design

Experience integrated security across onboarding, configuration, updates, and support. Conditional access, compliance policies, and device posture checks help protect devices and data without sacrificing productivity.

Frictionless employee experiences

Anticipate and resolve endpoint issues before users are affected, and deliver seamless onboarding, app access, and self-service tools to help employees stay productive anywhere.
